$comment: Lock the .NET SDK and explicitly declare WixToolset.Sdk version. The msbuild-sdks block tells MSBuild's default SDK resolver to fetch WixToolset.Sdk from NuGet rather than looking for it under %ProgramFiles%/dotnet/sdk/<ver>/Sdks/. Without this, building Installer/Installer.wixproj on the GitHub-hosted Windows runner fails with MSB4276.
